name: Beautiful.ai
summary: Presentation builder whose templates lay themselves out as you type.
best_for: founders, sales and small teams that want consistently good-looking decks fast, where design consistency matters more than pixel-level control
skip_if: you need intricate custom layouts or complex animations (designers want full control), or your whole company workflow is deeply PowerPoint-native
honest_knock: The smart-template engine is the feature and the fence: decks look polished with zero design skill precisely because the system constrains you, so pixel-perfect custom layouts and heavy brand exceptions fight the tool. And note the billing gap — $14.50/mo annual becomes $45 month-to-month, one of the steeper monthly premiums around. If your organisation lives in PowerPoint workflows, test the import/export round-trip before committing.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-02 on the vendor's own pricing page, amounts unchanged on 2026-09-29) Pro is $14.50/mo billed annually, up from $12 in our July and August 2026 captures ($45 for a one-off month); Team about $40/user/mo annual ($50 monthly) with brand controls and shared libraries; Enterprise custom for 20+ seats. A single one-off presentation can be bought for ~$45; 14-day trial. On 2026-09-29 the Team plan card itself read '$40 /MO (INCLUDES 3 USERS)' and 'Fixed pricing for up to three users', while the same page's summary and FAQ still say $40 per user per month for 2 to 20 seats, so confirm the seat price at checkout.
